title: D'vine Dev 6.5 Inch 8 Inch 10 Inch, Set of 3 Plastic Planter Pots for Plants with Drainage Hole and Seamless Saucers, Black Color, Large, 74-V-B-4

reviews.title: These are great, make them in more sizes please!
reviews.body: I'm a bit of a snob when it comes to pots, I always go with terra cotta or ceramic, I'm not a fan of plastic pots at all. But we recently rented a studio/office space with huge loft windows and a southwest exposure so I could finally get all the tropical plants I've wanted but which would not be happy in my home. The only issue is that I know we won't rent there forever, and it's up a huge flight of stairs, so I didn't want to be struggling with heavy ceramic pots the next time we move. This three pack of pots is great! The black color is matte enough to not scream "plastic", and they have drainage holes, saucers, and even come with screen to put on the bottom to keep the dirt from coming out. I usually have to cut my own screen so this was a thoughtful touch and I was impressed. These are lightweight and my only concern is that the saucers aren't very deep, but I think they will work out fine. You'll just want to be careful if you typically give your plants a good soaking, because they could possibly overflow. I wish these came in a larger sized set, and I would also love the option to purchase more of individual sizes. I just ordered a second set. They are a great value and better looking than what you can find in the typical garden center too!They shipped in their own retail box, rather than inside a shipping box, and arrived in fine shape. I appreciate that an extra box wasn't wasted for shipping.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on April 6, 2021
reviews.author: Lynn B.

reviews.title: Sleek, Sturdy, and Perfect for Small Plants!
reviews.body: I’m really impressed with this set of D’vine Dev plastic planter pots! The three sizes (4”, 5”, and 6”) are just right for repotting smaller indoor plants like succulents, herbs, or baby pothos. The matte black finish gives them a modern, clean look that blends beautifully with any décor—whether you have a minimalist setup or a cozy jungle vibe.Each pot includes a drainage hole and a perfectly fitting, seamless saucer that catches excess water without any mess. It’s a great balance between function and style, and the plastic feels thick and durable—not the cheap, flimsy kind. They’re lightweight but still feel very solid and well-made.If you’re looking for simple, elegant, and practical pots for your smaller houseplants, this set is a great value. I love that they come in a matching trio—ideal for creating a cohesive look across your space. Highly recommend for both new and seasoned plant parents!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 22, 2025
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: There's a Perfect Pot Size for Every Plant!
reviews.body: My daughter hooked me up with this brand of pots last year. They are the cream of the crop in plant pots, done in plastics. They look beautiful, and are made out of premium materials. Each pot comes with a fitted draining dish and a screen circle to keep the dirt in the pot when watering.. For those artistic types that are able to oil paint landscapes or designs, these pots would make a great canvas for creating a one-of- a-kind stage to show off your favorite succllents, cactus, or any other plant. I chose the earthy green and clay colors, which work well together. The pots are sturdy, not easily tipped over, and they drain well. They have sizes for individual plants, and larger ones to design a variety display pot. My daughter buys the large variety of sizes in one box, which is a great buy if you're looking ahead. I'm just starting out so a couple of three-packs like this purchase --was perfect!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on April 12, 2026
reviews.author: J. B.

reviews.title: Great quality pots that will last
reviews.body: The pots are good quality thicker plastic and the color is exactly what you would expect. They are not flimsy or cracked. It worked exactly for what I needed. I like that you have two separate parts to each pot for excellent drainage that allows you to adjust the moisture in the soil that best fits that particular plant. It comes with a fine mesh circle that you put in the bottom of each pot to help prevent soil loss when watering. I'm impressed at the quality of these pots for their price point.

reviews.title: Great quality, great price!
reviews.body: These are thick, sturdy plastic with a black matte finish on the outside and a glossy finish on the inside. Large ventilation rings in the bottom. Rest into bottom trays, do not snap on like other pots. Comes with rust resistance drainage nets so you don't lose your soil from the bottom. I haven't used these yet, just received them but I am very impressed with both the quality and the price of this item!

features: Seamless & Minimalist Design: Modern straight cylinder shaped planter pots with drainage hole and seamless detachable saucer.

Uncompromising Plastic: Pots are made with premium plastic with thick-walled and matte finishing, extremely durable, light-weighted, fragile-free. These small plants pot can accompany your lovely plants for a lifetime.
Large Set of 3 Planter Pots: 6.5 Inches, 8 Inches, 10 Inches in Diameter & Height with tray/saucer included - Plants in the images are not included.
Drainage Hole & Saucer: Drainage holes at the bottom of the pot, with seamless design detachable, and perfectly fitting saucers included.

Drainage Mesh Net Included: Place inside to cover the drainage hole and prevent potting soil from failing off the drainage hole, while still allowing water draining and keep soil ventilated for plants growth.
